svg.title: Slant — Every thought deserves a frame
svg.desc: “Thoughts are passing clouds. Left alone, they vanish into thin air. Gathered and condensed, they bring the rain that nourishes the earth.” When an insight crosses your mind, what will you do — let it drift past, or slant it? EVERY THOUGHT DESERVES A FRAME.
svg.metadata: Standalone scalable editorial quote panel. Colourful frame, original-style nib-and-thinker logo and cloud-and-rain illustration. All visible artwork and lettering are vector outlines; no external fonts, images or scripts. Resize proportionally.
